armyRules.name: Fenrisian Fury
armyRules.flavor: The Wolves fight with their whole bodies and are not good at waiting.
benefits: A Model with this Special Rule adds 1 to its Attacks Characteristic on a Battle Turn in which its Unit makes a Charge.
drawbacks: At the start of its Assault phase, a Unit with this Special Rule must declare a Charge against the nearest enemy Unit within 8" if it is able to.

armyRules.name: Saga-Bound
armyRules.flavor: A Space Wolves lord has sworn his boasts before the hall and cannot take them back.
benefits: A Model with this Special Rule adds 1 to its Attacks Characteristic while it is taking part in a Challenge.
drawbacks: A Model with this Special Rule can never decline a Challenge. If it is slain, every friendly Space Wolves Unit within 12" of it must make a Cool Check with a -1 modifier.

armyRules.name: Keen Senses
armyRules.flavor: Fenrisian hunters smell an ambush before it is sprung.
benefits: A Model with this Special Rule adds 1 to its Intelligence Characteristic.
Enemy Units cannot use the Infiltrate (X) or Outflank Special Rules to enter play within 12" of a Unit with this Special Rule.
drawbacks: A Model with this Special Rule subtracts 1 from its Leadership Characteristic.

wargear.name: Wolf-skull totem
wargear.summary: A pole hung with the skulls of beasts the pack has run down, and the teeth of a few men.
wargear.text: A Unit that includes a Model equipped with a Wolf-skull totem has the Fear (1) Special Rule.

wargear.name: Wolf-pelt mantle
wargear.summary: A heavy cloak cut from a Fenrisian beast the bearer killed alone.
wargear.text: A Model equipped with a Wolf-pelt mantle has the Feel No Pain (6+) Special Rule.

wargear.name: Skald's saga-horn
wargear.summary: A great horn from which a skald sounds the deeds of the pack so that no brother fights unremembered.
wargear.text: A Model equipped with a Skald's saga-horn has the Rousing Saga Special Rule.

wargear.name: Jarl's drinking horn
wargear.summary: A horn of Fenrisian mead that must be drained before battle.
wargear.text: A Unit that includes a Model equipped with a Jarl's drinking horn has the Mead of Heroes Special Rule.

wargear.name: Fang-talisman
wargear.summary: A rune-carved fang worn by Rune Priests against the Warp.
wargear.text: A Unit that includes a Model equipped with a Fang-talisman has the Rune-Ward Special Rule.

wargear.name: Chain-snares
wargear.summary: Weighted chains thrown to bind the legs of prey.
wargear.text: A Model equipped with Chain-snares has the Snare-Chains Special Rule.

wargear.name: Rune-sight
wargear.summary: A rune-etched targeter fitted to a hunter's helm.
wargear.text: A Model equipped with a Rune-sight has the Predator's Eye Special Rule.

wargear.name: Bone-trophy racks
wargear.summary: Skulls and tusks lashed to a hull until it looks like a hunting lodge on tracks.
wargear.text: A Vehicle equipped with Bone-trophy racks has the Skull-Strewn Hull Special Rule.

The Death Wolf walks beside them: 5+ Invulnerable Save, -1 I.

rules.name: Run Down the Prey
rules.summary: The pack strikes when the herd is already moving.
rules.text: A Unit composed entirely of Models with this Special Rule that enters play from Reserves treats any Charge Roll it makes in that Battle Turn that is lower than 6 as a 6.

rules.name: Oathsworn Hearthguard
rules.summary: The Jarl's hearth-companions do not give ground.
rules.text: A Unit with this Special Rule adds 1 to its Cool Checks and cannot be given the Pinned Tactical Status.

rules.name: Blood-Howl
rules.summary: When the pack is half gone the beast takes over, and the beast does not run.
rules.text: Once a Unit with this Special Rule has lost half or more of its starting Models, it has the Feel No Pain (6+) Special Rule and automatically passes Cool Checks. While it is above half strength, it subtracts 1 from its Cool Checks.

rules.name: Thunder of the Wild Ride
rules.summary: The riders crest the rise at full gallop, and do not slow for the enemy line.
rules.text: A Unit with this Special Rule that Rushes may still declare a Charge in the same Battle Turn, but subtracts 2" from the result of its Charge Roll.

rules.name: Rousing Saga
rules.summary: The skald sings the deeds of the pack, and none wish to be the verse that ends badly.
rules.text: While a friendly Space Wolves Unit is within 12" of a Model with this Special Rule, it adds 1 to its Cool Checks.

rules.name: Mead of Heroes
rules.summary: A horn of mead drained, a boast sworn, an axe swung harder.
rules.text: Once per battle, at the start of a Combat, the Controlling Player may declare that a Unit including a Model with this Special Rule adds 1 to the Attacks Characteristic of its Models until the end of that Battle Turn.

rules.name: Rune-Ward
rules.summary: A carved fang to turn the Warp's breath aside.
rules.text: When an enemy Model makes a Psychic Check that targets a Unit including a Model with this Special Rule, it subtracts 1 from the result.

rules.name: Snare-Chains
rules.summary: A weighted chain around the ankle ends a duel before it begins.
rules.text: Enemy Models that are Locked in Combat with a Model with this Special Rule subtract 1 from their Initiative Characteristic.

rules.name: Predator's Eye
rules.summary: The hunter picks out the one that ran and fixes on it.
rules.text: A Model with this Special Rule adds 1 to the result of its Hit Tests when making a Shooting Attack against a Unit that Rushed during its Controlling Player's last Battle Turn.

rules.name: Skull-Strewn Hull
rules.summary: Trophies lashed to the plates leave no doubt who rides within.
rules.text: A Vehicle with this Special Rule has the Fear (1) Special Rule.

rites.name: The Long Hunt
rites.flavor: A wolf-pack does not charge the herd. It follows, and it waits, and it picks the moment.
benefits: Jorlund Hunter Packs may fill Troops slots and gain Line (1).
Hunter Packs, Reconnaissance Squads and Scout Squads gain Outflank and Run Down the Prey: a Unit that arrives from Reserves treats any Charge Roll lower than 6 as a 6 in that Battle Turn.
limitations: At least one Jorlund Hunter Pack is required.
At least one unit with Run Down the Prey must start the battle in Reserves.
No Armour units and no Heavy Transports.

modifiers.text: The Long Hunt: Line (1).
The Long Hunt: Run Down the Prey, Outflank.

require.note: Bring at least one Jorlund Hunter Pack.

rites.name: Hall of the Wolf Guard
rites.flavor: When the Jarl's hearth-companions march, no one else needs to stand in the line.
benefits: Varagyr Wolf Guard Terminators may fill Troops slots and gain Line (1).
Varagyr gain Oathsworn Hearthguard: they add 1 to their Cool Checks and cannot be Pinned.
limitations: At least one Varagyr pack is required.
No Transport units and no Fast Attack units.

modifiers.text: Hall of the Wolf Guard: Line (1), Oathsworn Hearthguard.

require.note: Bring at least one Varagyr pack.

rites.name: The Wolf Within
rites.flavor: Some packs go quiet when the moon rises. Their Wolf Lords stop counting how many come home.
benefits: Deathsworn Packs may fill Troops slots.
Grey Slayer Packs and Deathsworn Packs gain Blood-Howl: once the Unit is at half strength or less it gains Feel No Pain (6+) and automatically passes Cool Checks.
They also add 1 to their Attacks Characteristic on a Battle Turn in which they Charge.
limitations: While above half strength, Grey Slayer and Deathsworn Packs subtract 1 from their Cool Checks.
At least one Grey Slayer Pack is required.
No Casters of Runes of any kind, and no Heavy Support, Tactical Support or Veteran Heavy Support Squads.

modifiers.text: The Wolf Within: Blood-Howl.
The Wolf Within: +1 A.
modifiers.condition: on a turn the unit charges

require.note: Bring at least one Grey Slayer Pack.

rites.name: The Wild Ride
rites.flavor: On Fenris the great beasts were ridden before the Legion ever knew a word for armour.
benefits: Outrider Squadrons and Attack Bike Squadrons may fill Troops slots and gain Line (1) and Fast (1).
They gain Thunder of the Wild Ride: after Rushing they may still declare a Charge, subtracting 2" from the Charge Roll.
limitations: At least two Outrider Squadrons are required.
No Heavy Assault, Armour or Heavy Transport units.

modifiers.text: The Wild Ride: Line (1), Fast (1), Thunder of the Wild Ride.

require.note: Bring at least two Outrider Squadrons.
